title: Get The Girl
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Nellie arrives as the new manager, causing confusion among the office staff. She evaluates employees, offers raises, and praises some, while conflicts and misunderstandings unfold, especially involving Erin and Andy’s relationship. The episode explores office dynamics, management challenges, and personal relationships, ending with unresolved tensions and uncertainties about future outcomes.
